findings.title: Keep the registered metric alert handler instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits StatefulDetectorHandler but does not implement its abstract counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, or build_occurrence_and_event_data members. It remains registered as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler, so accessing detector.detector_handler for a metric_alert_fire detector now raises TypeError when the property tries to instantiate it. Consequently, process_detectors aborts rather than returning the previous no-op result, also preventing subsequent detectors in the batch from being processed. Implement the required members or retain a concrete no-op handler until the stateful implementation is ready.
